Sorø is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across Denmark, specifically focusing on Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke through anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. 

To support local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system, the report provides a detailed breakdown of data for all 98 Danish municipalities using records from the National Patient Register (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Database (DanStroke) [^src1]. Sorø's specific performance metrics regarding apoplexy events among atrial fibrillation patients are recorded in the Indicator 5 calculations on page 94 of the report [^src1]. Because the available evidence consists solely of this single tabular mention, no further narrative details, relationships, or historical timeline events regarding Sorø are documented in this corpus.
